description: Vélib' - Localisation et caractéristique des stations is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autolib Velib Métropole. Jeu de données présentant les caractéristiques et la localisation des stations Vélib’ Métropole. Pour en savoir plus sur le service Vélib’"). Coverage: Autolib Velib Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Vélib' - Местоположение и характеристики на гарите" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autolib Velib Métropole. Its keywords include mobilites, velo, deplacements-transports, mobilite-douce, 2-roues. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
